mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: OL exists to build technology that makes businesses operate better. We combine software engineering expertise with artificial intelligence to create tools that are powerful, private, and accessible.

team.title: Our Team
team.description: OL is powered by teams of developers, programmers, and software engineers who share a commitment to building exceptional technology. We leverage flagship AI systems — including Anthropic's Claude — to accelerate our development and deliver intelligent solutions.

items.title: Privacy First
items.description: We believe technology should serve its users, not exploit them. Every product we build is designed with privacy as a foundation — no tracking, no advertising, no data selling.

items.title: Engineering Excellence
items.description: We hold ourselves to the highest standards of software craftsmanship. Clean architecture, thorough testing, and meticulous attention to detail define our work.

items.title: Accessibility
items.description: Technology should be available to everyone. We design for inclusivity, ensuring our products work for all users regardless of ability.

items.title: Transparency
items.description: We operate with clarity and honesty. Our pricing is fair, our policies are straightforward, and our code speaks for itself.

tech.title: Our Technology
tech.description: We work with the most advanced tools and frameworks available — from Swift and SwiftUI for native iOS development to React and Next.js for web platforms, powered by AI from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.
